channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Lights, camera, Active in Rosyth
item.description: HMS Active rolled out of the build hall at Rosyth this week, and you could feel what it meant to the people there. The post Lights, camera, Active in Rosyth first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Scot Gov backs expanded skills pipeline for shipbuilding
item.description: Deputy First Minister Kate Forbes has set out how the Scottish Government is seeking to strengthen the skills base behind major shipbuilding programmes such as the Type 31 frigates at Rosyth. The post Scot Gov backs expanded skills pipeline for shipbuilding first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ukrainian drone firm opens British factory
item.description: A Ukrainian drone manufacturer has officially opened its first UK production facility in an expansion of defence industrial cooperation between London and Kyiv. The post Ukrainian drone firm opens British factory first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Is Hegseth’s future at the Pentagon uncertain?
item.description: Controversy over operations, conduct and civil military tensions has cast uncertainty over Pete Hegseth’s standing at the Pentagon, Dorcha Lee, former Irish Defence Forces Provost Marshal and Director of Military Police, argues. The post Is Hegseth’s future at the Pentagon uncertain? first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British warship downs drones and missiles off UK coast
item.description: Royal Navy destroyer HMS Duncan has faced a sustained barrage of drone and missile threats during a concentrated 72-hour exercise off the Welsh coast. The post British warship downs drones and missiles off UK coast first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Government silent on UK Nightfall procurement plans
item.description: The Government has declined to say whether the UK intends to procure the Nightfall ballistic missile, instead pointing to the forthcoming Defence Investment Plan for decisions on Britain's future precision strike. The post Government silent on UK Nightfall procurement plans first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British warship downs drones and missiles off UK coast
item.description: HMS Duncan confronted swarms of surface and aerial drones, alongside simulated cruise and ballistic missile threats, as part of Exercise Sharpshooter. The post British warship downs drones and missiles off UK coast first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK and Norway sign new naval helicopter pact
item.description: The United Kingdom and Norway have signed a new agreement deepening helicopter cooperation between their navies, allowing British aircraft to operate from Norwegian warships and bases. The post UK and Norway sign new naval helicopter pact first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No decision yet on British-built Hawk successor
item.description: Plans for a successor to the Hawk jet trainer will be detailed in the forthcoming Defence Investment Plan, with ministers declining to confirm whether any replacement would be procured from a British company. The post No decision yet on British-built Hawk successor first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Pollard backs shipbuilding drumbeat and new UK work
item.description: Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry Luke Pollard calls for a steady UK shipbuilding drumbeat, backed by domestic orders and exports, urges investment in skills, and says future opportunities will extend beyond 6,000-tonne warships as the pipeline expands. The post Pollard backs shipbuilding drumbeat and new UK work first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
